caption: The drawing features a detailed, shaded illustration of a teapot or coffee pot as the central object. The pot is cylindrical with a slightly domed, lidded top that has a small knob at the peak. The spout is elongated, curved, and projects from the left side of the pot, while an ornate, sculpted handle is attached to the right side. The body and lid of the pot have simple horizontal band decorations. The main image is rendered in grayscale pencil or possibly ink, giving a metallic appearance, and there is a small brownish stain on the central part of the pot. Surrounding the central illustration, three smaller line drawings provide technical views: the lower left shows a profile and cross-section of the pot, the lower center displays a sectional or internal detail alongside a handle profile, and the lower right offers a top-down view showing the circular lid and body, all enclosed in fine-lined squares. The entire composition is set on an off-white or light beige background, with faint pencil guidelines demarcating the main and subsidiary drawings.
title: Pewter Coffee Pot
